base.prompt: Edit target: the attached 752 x 1344 illustration. Create the BASE layer for a layered PSD by removing ONLY both eyes (irises, pupils, whites, eyelashes, eyelid lines), both visible eyebrows, and the small closed smiling mouth. Fill those small feature regions seamlessly with the surrounding facial skin and shading. Keep the nose and its white highlight, face contour, ears, blush, hair and hair ribbons, neck, dress, arms, hands, legs, socks and shoes identical in geometry and appearance. Preserve the character's exact canvas position, scale, pose and full body framing. Do not draw closed eyes or mouth remnants; the face should have natural smooth skin where features were. Also extract the character from the white background: background OUTSIDE the character must be truly transparent alpha, including holes between arms and body, fingers, hair wisps, legs and around shoes. Preserve all white clothing, white eye-independent skin highlights and bright hair highlights; do not treat white objects as background. Do not add shadow, halo, glow, fog, text or checkerboard. Preserve the original canvas aspect ratio and preferably exact 752 x 1344 pixel size. This is precise-object-edit plus background-extraction; input image is the edit target, not inspiration.

features.prompt: Edit target: the attached 752 x 1344 anime illustration. Create one transparent PNG with ONLY the existing paired eyes, the existing visible paired eyebrows, and the existing tiny closed smiling mouth from this image, all at their exact ORIGINAL canvas coordinates and original relative sizes. Keep both eyes together with iris, pupil, eye whites, eyelash and eyelid lines; retain the blue iris details and white highlights exactly. Keep only visible eyebrow segments, respecting the existing hair occlusion: do NOT complete invisible brows. Keep the original subtle small smiling mouth line. Remove all surrounding facial skin, nose, blush, hair, body, clothing and background to truly transparent alpha. Necessary antialiased outline pixels should remain, but do not include large skin patches or any blonde hair. Do not redraw or redesign the features, do not change expression, do not independently center or enlarge any feature, do not pack parts into a grid, do not move anything. The output canvas must retain the original 752 x 1344 aspect ratio and the three kinds of features at their original coordinates (the face is near the upper center). No text, border, checkerboard, labels, or extra markings. Input image is the edit target. Output will be sliced into eye/brow/mouth layers by the PSD editor, so original shared coordinates are critical.
